headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM THIS EVENING THROUGH TUESDAY AFTERNOON

periods.name: Today
periods.text: South winds 5 to 10 knots. Mostly sunny. Waves 1 foot or less.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Southwest winds 5 to 10 knots becoming northwest and increasing to 15 to 25 knots overnight. A chance of rain in the evening. Waves 1 to 3 feet building to 3 to 5 feet. Waves occasionally around 6 feet.

periods.name: Monday
periods.text: Northwest winds 15 to 20 knots diminishing to 10 to 15 knots. Sunny. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Monday night
periods.text: Northwest winds 15 to 20 knots becoming north. Partly cloudy. Waves 1 to 3 feet building to 2 to 4 feet, then subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Tuesday through Thursday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 52 degrees, off Cleveland 54 degrees, and off Erie 51 degrees.
